items.summary: Learn how to expose an Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base to AI agents as MCP tools through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway while keeping per-user access control. A request interceptor injects verified identity, Policy in AgentCore validates it independently, and a resource-based policy restricts direct access to the knowledge base.

items.summary: Amazon Bedrock provides built-in, zero-instrumentation cost attribution that traces every inference call back to the IAM principal that made it. This post shows how to attribute per-user Bedrock costs for AI developer and productivity tools using IAM Identity Center, session tags, and CUR 2.0, and how to enforce per-user usage limits.
items.title: Cost attribution and controls for AI developer and productivity tools on Amazon Bedrock
